# Disk

`c.Disk` calls the API's Disk group. Get the disk usage of target hosts.

## Methods

| Method                       | Returns                            | Permission  | Description                     |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------- |
| [`Get(ctx, hostname)`](#get) | `*Response[Collection[DiskEntry]]` | `disk:read` | Get the disk usage of the host. |

### Get

```go
func (s *DiskService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[DiskEntry]], error)
```

Get the disk usage of the host.

Reads the size, the used space and the free space of each local filesystem, in
bytes: the mounts of /proc/mounts on Linux and of mount on macOS, with their
sizes from df. Local is ext4, xfs and btrfs on Linux, and apfs and hfs on macOS.
Network and special filesystems are left out.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/disk`, and needs the permission `disk:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host with one local filesystem, `go run disk.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Disk.Get(ctx, target)
```
